title: Integrating forecasting and replenishment across a newly acquired retailer
summary: Helped connect Bluemercury’s separate retail data estate to an enterprise forecasting and replenishment workflow through secure ingestion, semantic mapping, history construction, audits, and purchase-order interfaces.

title: Advancing a governed Teradata-to-BigQuery modernization
summary: Contributed to an early cloud-data modernization effort that paired migration engineering with source-key analysis, partitioning, change detection, reconciliation, access governance, and cost observability.

title: Reconciling valid records when enterprise systems disagree
summary: Developed layered controls for technical audits, business-state balancing, temporal checks, proactive alerts, and restart-aware recovery rather than treating schema validity as proof of correctness.

title: Making incident evidence measurable
summary: Extended observability beyond infrastructure health by tracking whether telemetry was complete, timely, contradictory, and recoverable—the basis for accepted research with published evaluation results.

title: Governing AI-assisted data standardization
summary: Designed controls around context, provenance, ownership, review, and validation so AI-assisted standardization could support enterprise workflows without hiding uncertainty.
